meta.usage: Internal source of truth for every language version. Not deployed: docs/ is excluded by .assetsignore. English pages remain the public master; localised pages must not change scope, fees, MOQ, QC or liability wording.
meta.rule: If a fact is marked conflict or pending, do not publish a new value until the owner confirms it.

warehouse.detail: Warehouse in the Yiwu–Jinhua area used for receiving, inspection, kitting and consolidation.

amazon_brands_served.rule: Cumulative brands served, never described as active clients. Owner confirmed 50+ on 2026-11-26; all public languages must use 50+.

supply_chain_experience.rule: Team supply-chain experience, never described as the age of the company.

amazon_us.value: Live Amazon US customers and deliveries
amazon_us.rule: Describe as experience, not as a marketplace guarantee or ranking.

billing_rules: Charged per order, not per SKU
Large or complex orders may be adjusted after written agreement
included: QC report with every managed order
forbidden_claims: 3–8% of order value as the standard fee
Competitor fee ranges or auditor day rates
USD 50 covers every kitting, packaging, storage or freight cost

moq.rule: MOQ depends on the product, stock, tooling and supplier.
moq.stock_items: Some stocked items can ship from 1 piece.
moq.custom_items: Logo, tooling and packaging MOQ depends on the production method.
forbidden_claims: Custom runs start at 50 pieces as a site-wide rule

qc.first_order: 100% inspection according to the agreed product and inspection requirements.
qc.repeat_order: AQL 2.5 sampling where applicable and confirmed with the buyer.
boundaries: QC report is not product certification.
Standard inspection is not laboratory testing.
Compliance depends on product category, destination market and sales channel.
Legal, marketplace, contractual and optional testing requirements must stay separate.

allowed_claims: Multiple product categories from different suppliers
Two silicone suppliers coordinated around one shared logo tooling setup
Existing box plus domed epoxy resin logo explored as a branding alternative
Diagonal layout considered to use internal box space
forbidden_claims: Any cost, CBM or freight saving figure

allowed_claims: Buyer can keep existing suppliers and send components to the warehouse
Milebond can coordinate existing suppliers when authorised by the buyer
BOM and assembly steps can surface component-fit issues
forbidden_claims: Automatic transfer of supplier contracts or goods ownership

allowed_claims: Packaging options compared by component shape and quantity
Physical fitting used to compare layouts
Box dimensions, packed volume and shipping impact assessed
forbidden_claims: Invented savings amounts, percentages or delivery results

known_conflicts.description: llms.txt states 'Custom runs start at 50 pcs', which conflicts with the MOQ rule.
known_conflicts.proposed_action: Rewrite as product-dependent custom MOQ; do not change without approval.
